description: Read one public web page. Returns the page's main content as markdown for a given address. The page is fetched by a page-reading provider (Firecrawl today), which is named in the reply's `via` field. The page is third-party content.

max_result_tokens.description: Cap on the size of the reply. Default 3000, at most 6000.

objective.description: Optional: what you want from the page.

url.description: Full address of the page, starting with https://.

name: stork_scrape
title: Read a web page
